description: Model class for a bar chart. Provides get/set methods for configuring the chart, its axes, series, legend, guides, data labels, and temporal binning.

properties.name: _config
properties.description: Current configuration used for the bar chart.

properties.name: _chartType
properties.description: Literal chart type discriminator for bar charts.

properties.name: layerInfo
properties.description: Grouping of layer-related properties to be passed to external functions more compactly.

properties.name: resolveSetup
properties.description: Function that resolves the setup promise.

properties.name: dataStore
properties.description: Data store object that can be used to store any data needed for the chart.

properties.name: setupFinished
properties.description: Promise that resolves when the setup process is complete. Does not need to be awaited if `setup` has already been awaited; provided to await setup from other functions to avoid race conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Completes the async setup process for the bar chart model. Must be called before using the model.

params.name: params
params.description: The parameters to be used to set up the chart model.

methods.name: generateDefaultConfig
methods.description: Generates the default config object when creating a new bar chart.

methods.name: getSeriesHideOversizedStackedLabels
methods.description: Gets whether to hide oversized stacked labels of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, it will return `undefined`.

methods.name: setSeriesHideOversizedStackedLabels
methods.description: Sets whether to hide oversized stacked labels of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newValue
params.description: The new value for hiding oversized stacked labels.

methods.name: resetSeriesStyling
methods.description: Resets the series styling to the default styling.

methods.name: resetAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the series styling is able to be reset.

methods.name: getXAxisField
methods.description: Gets the x-axis field for the chart.

methods.name: setXAxisField
methods.description: Sets the x-axis field for the chart. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getAggregationType
methods.description: Gets the aggregation type for the bar chart.

methods.name: setAggregationType
methods.description: Sets the aggregation type for the chart. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

params.name: newAggregationType
params.description: The new aggregation type. Must be one of the values allowed by RESTStatisticType.

methods.name: getSplitByField
methods.description: Gets the split-by field for the chart.

methods.name: setSplitByField
methods.description: Sets the split-by field for the chart. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getNumericFields
methods.description: Gets the numeric fields array for the chart.

methods.name: setNumericFields
methods.description: Sets the numeric field or numeric fields array for the chart. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

params.name: newNumericFields
params.description: The new numeric field string or numeric fields array.

methods.name: getDataFilter
methods.description: Gets the data filter for the bar chart.

methods.name: setDataFilter
methods.description: Sets the data filter for the bar chart.

methods.name: getCustomSortValues
methods.description: Gets the list of the category values for the chart.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the sort order for the bar chart.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for the bar chart.

params.name: orderByList
params.description: The list of category values to order by.

methods.name: getOrderByList
methods.description: Gets the list of custom sort values for custom sort.

methods.name: setOrderByList
methods.description: Sets the list of custom sort values for custom sort.

params.name: newOrderByList
params.description: The new list of custom sort values.

methods.name: updateSeriesFromLayerFilter
methods.description: Updates the series based on the layer filter.

methods.name: getSeriesName
methods.description: Gets the name of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns `undefined`.

methods.name: setSeriesName
methods.description: Sets the name of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newName
params.description: The new name for the series.

methods.name: getSeriesColor
methods.description: Gets the color of the series based on the series index. If the index is out of bounds, returns `undefined`.

methods.name: setSeriesColor
methods.description: Sets the color of the series based on the series index.

params.name: newColor
params.description: The new color for the series.

methods.name: getOrderOfSeries
methods.description: Gets the order of the series array by returning an array of series ids.

methods.name: setOrderOfSeries
methods.description: Sets the order of the series array by providing an array of series ids.

params.name: newOrder
params.description: The new order of the series array.

methods.name: getStackedType
methods.description: Gets how the bars/lines should be placed when multiple series are rendered in the same chart (e.g. after a split-by operation). Only used for bar and line series. Default "sideBySide".

methods.name: setStackedType
methods.description: Sets how the bars/lines should be placed when multiple series are rendered in the same chart. Default "sideBySide".

methods.name: moveSeries
methods.description: Moves a series from one index in the series array to another.

params.name: fromIndex
params.description: Index to move the series from.

params.name: toIndex
params.description: Index to move the series to.

methods.name: moveCustomSortValuesInOrderByList
methods.description: Moves the custom sort values in-place for the order by list in the config. Should only be used when sort order is set to `customSort`.

params.name: fromIndex
params.description: The index to move the custom sort value from.

params.name: toIndex
params.description: The index to move the custom sort value to.

methods.name: resetConfig
methods.description: Resets the config to the default config.

methods.name: isSameChartAs
methods.description: Checks if the current chart model is for the same chart as another chart model.

params.name: otherModel
params.description: The other chart model to compare to.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Gets the current chart configuration object.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the chart configuration object.

methods.name: getChartType
methods.description: Gets the chart type.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Gets the associated layer.

methods.name: getChartId
methods.description: Gets the chart id.

methods.name: setChartId
methods.description: Sets the chart id.

methods.name: getTitleText
methods.description: Gets the chart title text.

methods.name: setTitleText
methods.description: Sets the chart title text.

methods.name: getDescriptionText
methods.description: Gets the chart description text.

methods.name: setDescriptionText
methods.description: Sets the chart description text.

methods.name: getChartTitleVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the chart title is visible. Even if visible, may not display if the title text is empty.

methods.name: setChartTitleVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the chart title is visible.

params.name: newVisibility
params.description: The new visibility state of the chart title.

methods.name: getDescriptionVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the chart description is visible. Even if visible, may not display if the description text is empty.

methods.name: setDescriptionVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the chart description is visible.

params.name: newVisibility
params.description: The new visibility state of the description.

methods.name: getTitleSymbol
methods.description: Gets the title text symbol. Contains styling information such as font, color, and symbol style.

methods.name: setTitleSymbol
methods.description: Sets the title text symbol.

methods.name: getDescriptionSymbol
methods.description: Gets the description text symbol. Contains styling information such as font, color, and symbol style.

methods.name: setDescriptionSymbol
methods.description: Sets the description text symbol.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Gets the background color of the chart.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the chart.

methods.name: setSeriesVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a series.

params.name: props
params.description: Object containing visible, seriesId, overlayType, sliceId, sliceData.

methods.name: getSeriesId
methods.description: Gets the series ID for a given series index. If the series index is out of bounds, returns `undefined`.

methods.name: getSeriesIndex
methods.description: Gets the series index for a given series ID. If the series ID is not found, returns `undefined`.

methods.name: getSeriesLength
methods.description: Gets the length of the series array.

methods.name: getChartSubType
methods.description: Gets the chart sub type of the series.

methods.name: setFetchNULLValues
methods.description: Sets whether to fetch `null` values for them to be counted or displayed as categories on the chart.

methods.name: getFetchNULLValues
methods.description: Gets whether to fetch `null` values for them to be counted or displayed as categories on the chart.

methods.name: emitConfigUpdate
methods.description: Emits a config update event.

methods.name: loadConfigFromLayer
methods.description: Loads the config based on the provided props.

params.name: params
params.description: layer: the layer to be used as data source; iLayer: layer description to use if layer is not provided; config: the config object to be loaded.

methods.name: getXAxisTitleText
methods.description: Gets the x-axis title text.

methods.name: setXAxisTitleText
methods.description: Sets the x-axis title text.

methods.name: getXAxisTitleVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the x-axis title is visible.

methods.name: setXAxisTitleVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the x-axis title.

methods.name: getMaxXBound
methods.description: Gets the maximum bound that is currently set for the x-axis.

methods.name: setMaxXBound
methods.description: Sets the maximum bound for the x-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getMinXBound
methods.description: Gets the minimum bound that is currently set for the x-axis.

methods.name: setMinXBound
methods.description: Sets the minimum bound for the x-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getXAxisTitleSymbol
methods.description: Gets the x-axis title text symbol.

methods.name: setXAxisTitleSymbol
methods.description: Sets the x-axis title text symbol.

methods.name: getAxisLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Gets the axis labels text symbol.

methods.name: setAxisLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Sets the axis labels text symbol.

methods.name: getAxisLinesSymbol
methods.description: Gets the axis lines symbol.

methods.name: setAxisLinesSymbol
methods.description: Sets the axis lines symbol.

methods.name: getYAxisTitleText
methods.description: Gets the Y-axis title text.

methods.name: setYAxisTitleText
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis title text.

methods.name: getYAxisTitleVisibility
methods.description: Gets the visibility of the Y-axis title.

methods.name: setYAxisTitleVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the Y-axis title.

methods.name: getMaxYBound

methods.name: setMaxYBound
methods.description: Sets the maximum bound for the y-axis. `null` means the maximum bound is automatically calculated. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getMinYBound
methods.description: Gets the minimum bound for the y-axis.

methods.name: setMinYBound
methods.description: Sets the minimum bound for the y-axis. `null` means the minimum bound is automatically calculated. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getXAxisValueFormat
methods.description: Gets the value format options for the x-axis.

methods.name: setXAxisValueFormat
methods.description: Sets the value format options for the x-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getYAxisValueFormat
methods.description: Gets the value format options for the y-axis.

methods.name: setYAxisValueFormat
methods.description: Sets the value format options for the y-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getXLogarithmic
methods.description: Gets whether logarithmic scale is enabled for the x-axis.

methods.name: setXLogarithmic
methods.description: Sets whether logarithmic scale is enabled for the x-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getYLogarithmic
methods.description: Gets whether logarithmic scale is enabled for the y-axis.

methods.name: setYLogarithmic
methods.description: Sets whether logarithmic scale is enabled for the y-axis. Must be awaited for the changes to take effect.

methods.name: getXAxisScrollbar
methods.description: Gets the x-axis scrollbar configuration.

methods.name: setXAxisScrollbar

methods.name: getYAxisScrollbar

methods.name: setYAxisScrollbar
methods.description: Sets the y-axis scrollbar configuration.

methods.name: getYAxisTitleSymbol
methods.description: Gets the y-axis title text symbol.

methods.name: setYAxisTitleSymbol
methods.description: Sets the y-axis title text symbol.

methods.name: getGridLinesSymbol
methods.description: Gets the grid lines symbol.

methods.name: setGridLinesSymbol
methods.description: Sets the grid lines symbol.

methods.name: getLegendVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the legend is visible.

methods.name: setLegendVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the legend is visible.

methods.name: getLegendTitleText
methods.description: Gets the legend title text.

methods.name: setLegendTitleText
methods.description: Sets the legend title text.

methods.name: getLegendTitleVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the legend title is visible.

methods.name: setLegendTitleVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether the legend title is visible.

methods.name: getLegendPosition
methods.description: Gets the legend position (which side of the chart the legend is displayed).

methods.description: Gets the legend text symbol.

methods.name: getColorMatch
methods.description: Gets whether the chart should attempt to match the data source's colors.

methods.name: setColorMatch
methods.description: Sets whether the chart should attempt to match the data source's colors.

methods.name: getRotatedState
methods.description: Gets whether the chart is rotated.

methods.name: setRotatedState
methods.description: Sets whether the chart is rotated.

methods.name: getDataLabelsVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether the data labels are visible.

methods.name: setDataLabelsVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the data labels.

methods.name: getDataLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Gets the data labels text symbol.

methods.name: setDataLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Sets the data labels text symbol.

methods.name: getGuideLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Gets the guide labels text symbol.

methods.name: setGuideLabelsSymbol
methods.description: Sets the guide labels text symbol.

methods.name: getGuideVisibility
methods.description: Gets whether a guide is visible.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the guide in the list of guides for the given axis orientation.

params.name: orientation
params.description: The axis orientation of the guide.

methods.name: setGuideVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether a guide is visible.

methods.name: getGuideStart
methods.description: Gets the start value of a guide.

methods.name: setGuideStart
methods.description: Sets the start value of a guide.

methods.name: getGuideEnd
methods.description: Gets the end value of a guide.

methods.name: setGuideEnd
methods.description: Sets the end value of a guide.

methods.name: getGuideName
methods.description: Gets the name of a guide.

methods.name: setGuideName
methods.description: Sets the name of a guide.

methods.name: getGuideLabelText
methods.description: Gets the guide label text.

methods.name: setGuideLabelText
methods.description: Sets the guide label text.

methods.name: getGuideAbove
methods.description: Gets whether the guide should be rendered above the other chart elements.

methods.name: setGuideAbove
methods.description: Sets whether the guide should be rendered above the other chart elements.

methods.name: getGuideStyle
methods.description: Gets the guide style.

methods.name: setGuideStyle
methods.description: Sets the guide style.

methods.name: getXGuidesLength
methods.description: Gets the number of guides in the X-axis guides list.

methods.name: addXAxisGuide
methods.description: Adds an X-axis guide.

params.name: index
params.description: The index to insert the new guide in the list of X-axis guides. If undefined, appended to the end.

methods.name: deleteXAxisGuide
methods.description: Deletes an X-axis guide.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the guide to delete. If undefined, the last guide in the list is deleted.

methods.name: getYGuidesLength
methods.description: Gets the number of guides in the Y-axis guides list.

methods.name: addYAxisGuide
methods.description: Adds a Y-axis guide.

params.name: index
params.description: The index to insert the new guide in the list of Y-axis guides. If undefined, appended to the end.

methods.name: deleteYAxisGuide
methods.description: Deletes a Y-axis guide.

params.name: index
params.description: The index of the guide to delete. If undefined, the last guide in the list is deleted.

methods.name: getTimeIntervalSize
methods.description: Gets the time interval size for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: setTimeIntervalSize
methods.description: Sets the time interval size for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: getTimeIntervalUnits
methods.description: Gets the time interval units for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: setTimeIntervalUnits
methods.description: Sets the time interval units for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: getTimeAggregationType
methods.description: Gets the time aggregation type for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: setTimeAggregationType
methods.description: Sets the time aggregation type for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: getTrimIncompleteTimeInterval
methods.description: Gets whether to trim incomplete time intervals for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: setTrimIncompleteTimeInterval
methods.description: Sets whether to trim incomplete time intervals for a temporal bar/line chart.

methods.name: getNullPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy which tells the chart how to handle null values. "null": break the bar where null values are present. "zero": treats null values as zero. "interpolate": bar series behaves like "null"; line series connects the lines across null values.

methods.name: setNullPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy which tells the chart how to handle null values.

methods.name: resetTimeInterval
methods.description: Resets the time interval to default for a temporal line chart.
